Malísimo el servicio de la gente dentro de la cafetería, full... 5 personas y no pudieron tomar bien el pedido ( 4 cafés y 4 tostados) .. no pasaron el pedido a la cocina.. cuando hice el reclamo me dieron 3 cafés y los tostados helados. The service inside the café was terrible. It was packed... five people and they couldn't even take my order properly (four coffees and four toasted sandwiches). They didn't pass the order on to the kitchen. When I complained, they gave me three coffees and the toasted sandwiches were ice cold. We'll never go back! They really need to train them in customer service.
